Subject: Post-demo: security follow-up / SOC 2 & pen test request

Hi Jordan —

Great to meet you and team on the demo this morning. Quick recap and agreed next steps: 

- Redwood demoed the Dedicated deployment and routing features relevant to your multi-tenant ingestion flows.
- You asked for SOC 2 attestation, our pen test report (or guidance on sharing redacted findings), and details on our vulnerability management cadence.
- Agreed next step: I’ll loop in our security SME and share the SOC 2 doc + a short note on pen test process and timelines.

Jordan — can you confirm the list of recipients on your side who need the SOC 2 (legal, procurement, or just secops)? Also please share the vendor questionnaire if you have one — we can start filling it out in parallel.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa —

Please send SOC 2 Type II attestation (latest). Recipients: secops (me), Sanjay (engineering/security lead), and procurement for vendor onboarding.

We'd like access to:
- SOC 2 report (PDF)
- Any pen test summary you can share publicly — if only redacted summaries are available that's fine, but we need to understand scope and severity distribution.

Also attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (DOCX). If you can indicate who will own the questionnaire at Redwood, that'd help.

--

FinHealth

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Jordan — thanks, looping in Marcus (security lead) to own the questionnaire and pen test details, and Rachel (AE) for commercial/procurement sync.

Marcus / Rachel — Jordan at FinHealth needs: SOC 2 Type II (latest), a pen test summary or redacted report, and our vulnerability management SLAs and cadence. Jordan attached their vendor questionnaire — Marcus, can you confirm who will fill vs. what we can provide as doc excerpts?

Goal: get SOC2 and FAQ to Jordan today, indicate pen test sharing process (NDA if needed) and a timeline for questionnaire completion (ideally 3 business days for the bulk of answers).

Marissa

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@finhealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-29T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security follow-up / SOC 2 & pen test request

Thanks Marissa / Jordan —

Short answers up front:
- SOC 2: we can share our SOC 2 Type II attestation (2025 cycle) and a controls summary now. See attached.
- Pen test: Redwood conducts annual third-party penetration testing; the last engagement was March 2026. Full, unredacted pen test reports are considered sensitive and require an executed NDA. We can share a redacted executive summary (scope, major/critical findings count, remediation status) without an NDA.
- Vulnerability management: weekly authenticated/full scans, daily external vulnerability checks. SLA: critical = 72 hours to remediation plan + patching/mitigation cadence (varies by severity); high = 7 business days to remediation plan. We also publish a monthly vulnerability digest for customers with dedicated workloads.

Action items I can own:
1) Send SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf and Redwood_Security_FAQ_2026.pdf (attached) — sending now.
2) Review FinHealth questionnaire and propose owners/answers; aim to return a completed questionnaire or marked A/R by 3 business days (EOD 2026-08-03).
3) Prepare a redacted pen test executive summary for immediate sharing; if FinHealth requires the full report we'll request NDA and routing.

Jordan — attaching SOC2 and FAQ now. If you can confirm procurement NDA routing (DocuSign link or legal contact), I’ll start the full-report request.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Security Lead, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: SOC2_Attestation_2025.pdf; Redwood_Security_FAQ_2026.pdf

From: Jordan Miller <jordan.miller@finhealth.com>

Jordan
